relations.subject: Łucja Osborne
relations.evidence: She met Arthur Osborne (1906–1970) in Warsaw, where he was teaching English. They were married in 1934

relations.subject: Arthur Osborne
relations.evidence: Later he taught at Chulalongkorn University in Bangkok.

relations.subject: Łucja Osborne
relations.evidence: There she became a pupil of Ramana Maharshi and eventually learned Tamil.
